children: Dar Global, a leading luxury real estate developer, is reinforcing its commitment to the region's fastest-growing real estate markets by highlighting its flagship residential portfolio across Saudi Arabia and Qatar.

Following an exclusive Dubai preview presenting Dar Global's latest opportunities to top brokers and investors, the developer is expanding access to its premier project pipeline as both Saudi Arabia and Qatar solidify their standing as leading global real estate destinations, driven by historic economic reforms, massive infrastructure investment, and modernised foreign ownership frameworks.

In Saudi, historic real estate reforms have opened property ownership to non-Saudis under a structured digital framework, with the announcement of designated zones viewed as a major catalyst for international market entry. The Kingdom offers a unique structural advantage: a deep organic domestic market supported by national housing targets and long-term population growth, alongside no personal income tax, property-linked residency for investments over SAR4 million, and a US Dollar-pegged currency, Dar said.

Similarly, Qatar is driving international demand through designated foreign ownership zones and attractive real estate residency programmes (golden visas), granting foreign buyers multi-year or permanent residency, 0% capital gains tax, and full capital repatriation within landmark masterplans led by Qatari Diar.

Dar Global’s expanding regional footprint features three benchmark luxury destinations across both markets. Within Riyadh’s exclusive Diriyah, Wadi Safar district, the developer is progressing Rayana, offering Mansions and branded Trump Mansions the project’s strategic location is near King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD) and Expo 2030 corridors.

Meanwhile, Trump Plaza Jeddah anchors the Amaya development on King Abdulaziz Road, introducing Trump Park Residences, Trump Executive Residences, and Townhouses alongside a members-only Vitality Club. Across Qatar, Dar Global is advancing Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, in the heart of the capital Doha, featuring ultra-luxury golf and beachfront villas within Qatari Diar’s 8-million-square-metre Simaisma masterplan alongside a 650,000 sqm theme park “Land of Legends” and three hotels and a yacht marina.

Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “Following our engagement with leading brokers and investors, we are seeing immense appetite for luxury residences and second homes across Saudi Arabia and Qatar. In Saudi Arabia alone, buyers from 59 nationalities have already invested with us—demonstrating that global buyers are actively betting on the Kingdom’s trajectory even before foreign ownership zones are fully finalised. What makes Saudi Arabia fundamentally unique is its SAR 600 billion domestic market, giving international investors a built-in airbag, while Qatar’s world-class infrastructure and residency incentives continue to draw high-net-worth global citizens. Our developments across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Doha offer investors turnkey, world-class branded real estate in the region's most dynamic growth corridors.”
